friction_events: F-T0019-1 (medium, product-surface, for T-0021/E4.2): PROBE-E seq-rollback — choros_app holds GRANT UPDATE ON actor_event_seq, which it needs to advance next_seq. As choros_app, rolling next_seq BACKWARD into an unused lower slot succeeds; an actor_event row can then be INSERTed at that lower seq, landing ORDER BY seq BEFORE an already-committed row and inverting apparent SoD order (approve before submit). UNIQUE(tenant_id,seq) blocks reusing an occupied slot but NOT backfilling a lower gap. The append-only ROW guarantee and all 22 AC structural invariants are intact. Classification: WRITER threat surface (FR-7/§6.2 Out-of-Scope). Forward obligation for T-0021: add EITHER a BEFORE UPDATE trigger on actor_event_seq that rejects NEW.next_seq < OLD.next_seq (decrement guard), OR a writer-side assert inside appendActorEvent that the assigned seq > MAX(seq) for the (tenant_id, object) before the INSERT. Flag in T-0021 threat model.

forward_obligations.title: actor_event_seq no-decrement guard
forward_obligations.description: choros_app holds GRANT UPDATE ON actor_event_seq (necessary to advance next_seq). As-is, a call rolling next_seq BACKWARD into a lower unused slot succeeds, allowing a forged actor_event row to appear ORDER BY seq BEFORE a legitimately earlier row, inverting SoD order without violating UNIQUE(tenant_id,seq). T-0019's ledger shape is correct and all 22 AC pass. The gap is in the WRITER's perimeter (FR-7/§6.2).
forward_obligations.required_fix: T-0021 MUST implement at least one of: (A) BEFORE UPDATE trigger on actor_event_seq that raises EXCEPTION when NEW.next_seq < OLD.next_seq (decrement forbidden at DB layer, always-on); OR (B) writer-side assert inside appendActorEvent that the seq returned by the FOR UPDATE counter read is strictly greater than MAX(seq) for the (tenant_id, object_kind, <component_id>) scope before the INSERT. Option A is preferred (structural, CI-visible diff to defeat).
forward_obligations.threat_model_entry: seq-rollback attack: choros_app rolls next_seq backward, inserts approve@seq=970000 after submit@seq=970001 already committed; trail reads approve-before-submit; UNIQUE(tenant_id,seq) only blocks occupied slot, not gap backfill.
